messages:
jonah: Heads up — canary p95 for decode jumped from ~120ms -> ~320ms after the merge at 0af3b2e (PR #4319). Repro locally on seq>256, looks like a different attention kernel is being picked for some batches.

maria (perf): Saw the CI perf alert too (perf/runner/4891). Flamegraph: https://perf.internal/flame/4891 — selector flipped from attn_opt_v2 -> attn_generic on the hot path.

jonah: Quick profiler snippet I ran:```nvprof --profile-child-processes ./serve --input-seqs 64,512``` shows majority time spent in attn_gemm_fallback when seq=512. Also CPU-side batching stats show increased batch size variance.

eva (oncall): Is this related to the fused-op change that landed yesterday? PR touched kernel heuristics and batching ordering afaik.

rahul (merge): It did modify the selection heuristics for small-batch scheduling (to improve throughput), but I didn't expect it to flip for longer sequences. We should bisect before reverting — will start a quick bisect window.

maria (perf): I ran a local bisect on our perf harness — culprit appears to be commit 0af3b2e5: changed selector threshold 192->256 and introduced a cost-term that downweights KV-cache hits. That penalty makes the cost model prefer the generic kernel in mixed batch cases.

jonah: Can we override per-canary policy? Runtime config has KERNEL_POLICY that can pin variants — we can set KERNEL_POLICY=legacy_attn for the canary while we triage.

eva (oncall): Doing that now for the canary cluster. Rolling it back to legacy_attn — initial metrics: p95 dropped back to ~115ms on the canary.

ci-bot: perf/regression job #4891 flagged: p95 decode +180% vs baseline. Created ticket perf/4891.

rahul (merge): I'll open a revert PR for 0af3b2e5 to restore previous selector behavior and then reintroduce the cost-model changes behind a feature flag + regression tests. Also adding a follow-up to add a microbench for mixed-length batching + kv-warm cache.

jonah: SG. Also recommending we add a CI regression that runs a quick seq=512 warmup scenario to catch selector oscillations in future.

maria (perf): I'll draft that CI test today and add an assertion on kernel choice + p95 delta for canary lanes. :thumbsup:
